description: Arcadia-depth FSAE 2027 tasks for experiment 4 (bare agent + MCP, with and without skills, Sonnet and Haiku). Scored by native checks (if any) and method checks in harness-comparison/grade.groovy.
requires: The FSAE-2027-Electric-Arcadia model, the same pristine copy as fsae-2027.json.

tasks.prompt: The car has vehicle-level operating modes that the driver and team choose: off, low-voltage on, tractive system active, ready to drive, and charging. Model them in the logical architecture on 'FSAE2027:Electric Vehicle Logical System', the Arcadia way, with where the car starts, the allowed changes between them and what triggers each change. Then make the logical functions follow the modes: 'FSAE2027:DD Bound total wheel torque by driver demand' is available only when ready to drive, and 'FSAE2027:charging Recharge traction energy under protected conditions' only while charging.

function.name: FSAE2027:DD Bound total wheel torque by driver demand
FSAE2027:charging Recharge traction energy under protected conditions

tasks.prompt: Describe the information on two flows of 'FSAE2027:SD Independent BMS Logical monitor' in the logical architecture. 'FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip' is a discrete trip signal. 'FSAE2027:SD LA Cell voltage and sense validity' continuously carries the measured cell-group voltage, in volts, and whether each voltage sense line is valid. Give each functional exchange the exchange item that fits its nature, and define the cell-voltage data in the data model with proper types, including the unit.

exchange.name: FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip
FSAE2027:SD LA Cell voltage and sense validity
FSAE2027:SD LA Cell voltage and sense validity

tasks.prompt: Make the BMS shutdown trip an explicit interface contract in the logical architecture. The trip 'FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip' goes from 'FSAE2027:SD Independent BMS Logical monitor' to 'FSAE2027:SD Hardwired shutdown current path Logical subsystem'. It must travel on a component exchange between those two components, its information must be an exchange item, and an interface 'FSAE2027:BMS trip interface' must carry that item, with each component on the correct side of the contract.

exchange.name: FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip
FSAE2027:SD LA Independent BMS shutdown trip

consumer.name: FSAE2027:SD Hardwired shutdown current path Logical subsystem

tasks.prompt: In the system analysis, state what the car is for at competition: its missions, at least the static events and the dynamic events (split the dynamic events further if you like). Link each mission to the system capabilities it relies on, so that every system capability serves at least one mission.

The plausible driver torque request that 'FSAE2027:DD Detect APPS wiring range and plausibility failures' sends to 'FSAE2027:DD Bound total wheel torque by driver demand' must now also reach a new logical function 'FSAE2027:DD Log driver torque request', allocated to the same component as the detecting function. Both consumers receive the very same signal. Show that copy explicitly in the logical dataflow the way Arcadia models it.

source.name: FSAE2027:DD Detect APPS wiring range and plausibility failures

consumers.name: FSAE2027:DD Bound total wheel torque by driver demand

tasks.prompt: Record the safety data of the three independent trip monitors in the logical architecture as structured Capella property values, grouped the same way on each so a safety viewpoint can read them: whether the device is programmable, and its worst-case reaction time in milliseconds as a number. 'FSAE2027:SD Independent IMD Logical monitor': not programmable, 30000 ms. 'FSAE2027:SD Independent BMS Logical monitor': programmable, 500 ms. 'FSAE2027:DD Independent nonprogrammable BSPD Logical component': not programmable, 500 ms. Name the group 'Safety'.

element.name: FSAE2027:DD Independent nonprogrammable BSPD Logical component

tasks.prompt: Every functional exchange that brings a protective trip into 'FSAE2027:SD Accept independent shutdown trips' should be grouped as one family, 'FSAE2027:Shutdown trip', in the logical architecture, so that trips can be filtered and reasoned about together.
